parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
const dec = d.decision, ocr = d.ocr, fr = d.fraud, b = d.boundary, g = d.government, c = d.community, r = d.risk, v = d.valuationData;
const stepState = (ok) => dec.status === 'verified' ? 'completed' : (ok ? 'completed' : 'attention');

const wid = 'WF-N8N-' + String(d.passportId || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8).toUpperCase();

const result = {
  workflowId: wid,
  provider: 'n8n',
  propertyId: d.propertyId,
  passportId: d.passportId,
  status: dec.status,
  confidenceScore: d.confidenceScore,
  fraudScore: fr.fraudScore,
  fraudBand: fr.fraudBand,
  boundaryScore: b.boundaryScore,
  riskScore: r.riskScore,
  ocrConfidence: ocr.ocrConfidence,
  documentsVerified: ocr.documentsVerified,
  boundaryVerified: b.boundaryVerified,
  registryCrossCheck: g.registryCrossCheck,
  decisionReason: dec.decisionReason,
  reviewReasons: dec.reviewReasons,
  governmentScore: g.governmentScore,
  governmentCleared: g.governmentCleared,
  communityScore: c.communityScore,
  communityAttestations: c.communityAttestations,
  communityCleared: c.communityCleared,
  passportStatus: dec.passportStatus,
  currency: 'INR',
  valuation: v.valuation,
  completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  steps: [
    { name: 'Property submitted', status: 'completed', detail: 'Property accepted' },
    { name: 'Document / OCR check', status: stepState(ocr.documentsVerified), score: ocr.ocrConfidence, detail: ocr.missingFields.length ? ('Missing: ' + ocr.missingFields.join(', ')) : 'All required fields extracted' },
    { name: 'Fraud analysis', status: stepState(fr.fraudBand === 'Clear'), score: fr.fraudScore, detail: fr.fraudSignals.length ? (fr.fraudSignals.length + ' signal(s)') : 'No significant fraud signals' },
    { name: 'Boundary verification', status: stepState(b.boundaryVerified), score: b.boundaryScore, detail: b.boundaryVerified ? 'Boundary within tolerance' : 'Boundary conflict — escalate to surveyor' },
    { name: 'Government registry', status: stepState(g.governmentCleared), score: g.governmentScore, detail: g.governmentCleared ? 'Registry cleared' : 'Registry needs review' },
    { name: 'Community attestation', status: stepState(c.communityCleared), score: c.communityScore, detail: c.communityAttestations + ' attestation(s)' },
    { name: 'Risk analysis', status: stepState(r.riskScore < 45), score: r.riskScore, detail: r.riskBand + ' risk' },
    { name: 'Confidence engine', status: stepState(d.confidenceScore >= 78), score: d.confidenceScore, detail: d.confidenceScore >= 78 ? 'High confidence' : 'Confidence below threshold' },
    { name: 'Automated decision', status: 'completed', detail: dec.status === 'verified' ? 'Automatically approved' : (dec.status === 'rejected' ? 'Rejected' : 'Escalated to manual review') },
    { name: 'Passport readiness', status: dec.passportStatus === 'ready' ? 'completed' : 'attention', detail: dec.passportStatus === 'ready' ? 'Passport ready to issue' : 'Passport held' },
  ],
};

// Determine which downstream notification to raise.
const notifyType = dec.status === 'verified' ? 'passport_ready' : dec.status === 'rejected' ? 'fraud_alert' : 'manual_review_required';
const auditEvent = dec.status === 'verified' ? 'automated_approval' : dec.status === 'rejected' ? 'rejection' : 'manual_review_escalation';

return [{ json: { ...d, result, notifyType, auditEvent } }];
